name: Sora*yume
source:
Morinaga Satsuki is the only daughter of a family that owns an antique store, with no special redeeming features she is an extremely normal 2nd year high school student.
It's the 24th of August, with one week left in her summer vacation.
On the day that her parents leave for a business trip she spontaneously finds a sparkling yellow ring, the "Chrysoberyl".

When Satsuki took that ring and put it on, the man sealed inside was summoned into this world.
He called himself a demon called "Ruen Egrandin".
He semi-forcefully asked her to help him find the "Thing he was looking for", and as a reward he would grant her a "wish that wasn't particularly a wish".

The thing the demon was looking for was the demon stone "Heliotrope" which was set in another ring.

"That is a ring of destruction. Right after you put it on, no matter how much you struggle, you will easily lose your mind and go insane."
It's that kind of frightening ring.
However as long as you don't put it on, nothing bad will happen.

Under pressure from Ruen, Satsuki took on the request to find the Heliotrope ring without taking it too seriously.

From that day the demon and human would start working together.

Since meeting Ruen,
No, More like since finding that ring, It seems like the world has been swallowed by a dream.

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
森永皋月是古董店家中的独生女，没有任何特别突出的优点，只是一名极其普通的高中二年级学生。
时间是8月24日，距离暑假结束还剩1周。
父母因公出差的那一天，她偶然发现了一枚闪耀黄色光芒的“金绿宝石”戒指。

皋月拿起戒指戴上后，封印在其中的男人被召唤到这个世界。
他自称是名为“鲁恩·艾格兰汀”的恶魔。
他半强迫地要求皋月帮助寻找“自己想找的东西”，作为回报，则会替她实现一个“算不上愿望的愿望”。

恶魔所寻找的，是镶嵌在另一枚戒指上的魔石“日光石”。

“那是一枚毁灭之戒。戴上的瞬间，无论如何挣扎，都很容易失去理智、陷入疯狂。”
这是一枚如此可怕的戒指。
不过，只要不把它戴上，就不会发生任何坏事。

在鲁恩施压之下，皋月并未太当回事便接受了寻找日光石戒指的请求。

从那一天起，恶魔与人类开始携手合作。

自从遇见鲁恩，
不，或许该说自从发现那枚戒指以后，世界仿佛被梦境吞没。

[翻译自官方网站]
